    if min_deg < 1:
        return False, f"min degree {min_deg} < 1"
    if max_deg > 2:

    # Check edge count

        return False, f"edge count {num_edges} not in [9,11]"
    
    # Check chromatic number (must be exactly 2, i.e., bipartite and has at least one edge)
    # Bipartite check using BFS
    color = [-1] * n
    is_bipartite = True
    for start in range(n):
        if color[start] == -1 and adj[start]:
            queue = [start]
            color[start] = 0
            while queue:
                node = queue.pop()

                        color[nb] = 1 - color[node]
                        queue.append(nb)
                    elif color[nb] == color[node]:

    if not is_bipartite:
